commit_message:
Bug 1861078 - wasm: make metadata offsets relative to CodeBlock->codeBase. r=rhunt

Metadata used offsets to the beginning of code segment. Change that to use
offsets relative to the beginning of CodeBlock. This allows us to avoid offseting
metadata later on and prepare the work for simplification of stackmaps.

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D232671

fix_commit.message: Bug 1952215 - wasm: Fix calleePtr for lazy stubs. r=rhunt
fix_commit.author: Julien Pages

findings.title: Incorrect Base Pointer Used for Code Offset Calculation
findings.message: When calculating the calleePtr in createManyLazyEntryStubs, the code uses `tierCodeBlock.segment->base()` instead of `tierCodeBlock.base()`. This commit changed the semantics of all code offsets to be relative to CodeBlock::codeBase instead of segment->base(), but this particular location was missed. When the CodeBlock's codeBase differs from the segment base (which can happen when multiple code blocks share a segment), the calculated calleePtr will point to the wrong memory location. This causes the generated wasm entry stub to call an incorrect code pointer, potentially resulting in execution of arbitrary or unintended code within the module's code range.
findings.suggestion: Use tierCodeBlock.base() instead of tierCodeBlock.segment->base() to calculate the correct calleePtr. The CodeBlock::base() method returns codeBase which is the correct base for offset calculations after bug 1861078's refactor changed all metadata offsets to be relative to CodeBlock::codeBase.

ground_truth.root_cause: During the refactoring in bug 1861078 to make metadata offsets relative to CodeBlock::codeBase instead of segment->base(), one location in createManyLazyEntryStubs was not updated. The segmentBase variable continued to use tierCodeBlock.segment->base() when it should have used tierCodeBlock.base(). Since CodeBlock::codeBase can differ from segment->base() (multiple code blocks can share a segment with different offsets), using the wrong base results in calculating an incorrect calleePtr that points to the wrong code location.

must_cover.reason: Contains the vulnerable code at line 464 where segmentBase is incorrectly calculated using tierCodeBlock.segment->base() instead of tierCodeBlock.base(). This is the direct source of the bug where the wrong base pointer is used to calculate calleePtr, causing the generated stub to point to incorrect code location when CodeBlock's codeBase differs from segment->base().

Defines the correct base() method that should be used instead of segment->base(). Reviewing this shows that CodeBlock has its own base pointer (codeBase_) which can differ from the segment's base when multiple code blocks share a segment. Understanding this method reveals why using segment->base() is incorrect.

Defines the segment->base() method that is incorrectly used in the vulnerable code. Comparing this with CodeBlock::base() reveals the conceptual error: segment base is the raw memory base, while CodeBlock::base() accounts for the CodeBlock's offset within the segment. This comparison is essential to detect the bug.
